svg.title: Poster study: a passenger jet crash at an airport
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration at night: a white airliner lies broken in two beside the runway, its tail fin upright and flames at the break, a black smoke column rising into the sky; two yellow airport fire trucks spray arcs of foam onto it while firefighters in turnout gear work a hose in the foreground and an officer points toward the wreck. No victims shown. Fictional scenario for a style study.
